Remark 5.3 ([?, Remark 5.3, p. 3]). The converse of Corollary  ?? fails as soon as the support contains a cycle: the weighting that is \(1\) on every arrow of a directed cycle and \(0\) elsewhere is balanced and nonzero. What the corollary rules out is a balanced weighting whose support is acyclic, and that is the form in which Theorem  ?? is usually applied.
